prompts.label: T085 full-frame subject-sides atlas reference / Qwen 2511 / Canny / 4-step
prompts.prompt: Recover restrained archival film color for image1, a full-frame source-owned subject-sides element atlas for balanced shot0011. The atlas represents important shot subjects from multiple sides: front, back, left/profile, right/turn, plus the left-side people visible at the beginning and the right-side guests/materials. Use these real source crops to form one consistent color interpretation for the shot. Preserve exact source geometry, crop boundaries, grain, scratches, softness, exposure, shadows, weak details, and damaged edges. Image2 is only a soft non-spatial Belak calibration field. Image3 is source-derived Canny control and must stay aligned to image1. Do not merge tiles into one scene, add new people, windows, lamps, doors, portraits, labels, text, graphic borders, or extra room details. Do not copy chart patches. Use low-to-medium archival chroma: warm-neutral skin, dark brown/black hair, dark clothing charcoal/black-brown/deep muted navy, light clothing ivory/cream-gray, walls warm gray or muted aged plaster, wood/floor muted umber only where supported, and shadows low-chroma neutral.
prompts.control_source: full-frame source-derived Canny from T079 subject-sides visible-element atlas
